description: This file contains Pydantic schema models for API request/response data structures related to data management, validation, audit, and evidence handling.

classes.name: AuditContext
classes.description: Schema for audit context information for attributable actions.

classes.name: SignatureBlock
classes.description: Schema for electronic signature evidence.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Standard error response schema.

classes.name: DatasetReference
classes.description: Schema for referencing datasets within a package.

classes.name: SchemaField
classes.description: Definition of a schema field.

classes.name: SchemaDefinition
classes.description: Schema for overall schema definition including fields.

classes.name: ProductMetadata
classes.description: Metadata about a data product.

classes.name: ControlsMetadata
classes.description: Metadata related to controls and retention policies.

classes.name: DataProductPackage
classes.description: Definition of a data product package including product, dataset, schema, controls, and SOP references.

classes.name: CreateDraftRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a draft.

classes.name: CreateDraftResponse
classes.description: Response model after creating a draft.

classes.name: CreateSubmissionRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a submission.

classes.name: CreateSubmissionResponse
classes.description: Response model after creating a submission.

classes.name: GetSubmissionResponse
classes.description: Response model for retrieving submission details.

classes.name: ValidationCheck
classes.description: Schema for validation check results.

classes.name: ValidationReportSummary
classes.description: Summary of validation report.

classes.name: ApprovalPreconditions
classes.description: Preconditions required for approval.

classes.name: ApproveSubmissionRequest
classes.description: Request model for approving a submission.

classes.name: ApproveSubmissionResponse
classes.description: Response after approving a submission.

classes.name: TriggerValidationRequest
classes.description: Request to trigger validation.

classes.name: TriggerValidationResponse
classes.description: Response from triggering validation.

classes.name: AuditEvent
classes.description: Schema for audit event details.

classes.name: GetAuditEventsResponse
classes.description: Response containing list of audit events.

classes.name: EvidenceArtifact
classes.description: Reference to evidence artifact.

classes.name: EvidencePackageResponse
classes.description: Response schema for evidence package details.
